WITH sales_by_store AS (
  SELECT 
    `location_number`,
    SUM(`cy_sales`) AS cy_sales,
    SUM(`py_sales`) AS py_sales
  FROM `prashanth_subrahmanyam_catalog`.`sales_reports`.`mv_7now_fact_sales`
  WHERE `location_number` IS NOT NULL

  l.`city_name`,
  l.`region_name`
FROM sales_by_store s
JOIN `prashanth_subrahmanyam_catalog`.`sales_reports`.`mv_esr_dim_location` l
  ON s.`location_number` = l.`location_number`
ORDER BY s.`location_number`
